records.text: The scan shows the 学/學 entry stating “本义是学习、效法,” proposing learning and emulation or following as a model as the original meaning. The entry ends with 張標’s credit on this page; a separate 斆 headword begins below. PDF p. 278, printed p. 266, continues 斆, not 學. The formation discussion distinguishes a rare element read jù, described as hands or claws, from a separate proposal involving two 臼 forms with 冖. The unusual drawn forms remain unresolved as Unicode identities. This is the entry’s attributed account, not established consensus. I inspected the supplied scan pixels for PDF p. 277 (printed p. 265) and p. 278 (printed p. 266).
